about: Codex reference pictures for Kestrel. 'male'/'female' map a review-page view to a file (the compare page reads these); 'groups' is the gallery on ref/index.html.

groups.title: Owner's mockup
files: the design every picture comes from

groups.title: Turnaround sheets
groups.note: Four views in one picture: front, left, back, right. Use for services that take one sheet.

groups.title: Matched set (cut from the sheets)
groups.note: Front, left, back, right cut from ONE sheet, so they agree exactly. Best for multi-view services (four pictures).

groups.title: Single high-detail views
groups.note: 1024x1536 each, drawn one at a time (so small differences between them). Best for one-picture services: use the front.

groups.title: Head close-ups
groups.note: Front, left, back, 3/4 of the head, for face detail.
